text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian triumphs against Biwa Hayahide in an impressive show!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sisters promise to have a rematch. Although in awe of her sister's performance, Biwa Hayahide is confident that Narita Brian will be the one chasing after her next time.
